engine: SQLite STRICT ANY with native JSON functions (in-memory)
case: json_extract() dynamic storage classes through JSON, XLSX and typed CSV consumers
contract: A single json_extract(document, '$.v') expression returns INTEGER, REAL, TEXT and SQL NULL values from STRICT ANY documents.
The corpus includes maximum signed 64-bit integer, real, numeric-looking string, JSON boolean, JSON null, object, array, reserved-tag-shaped string and a missing path.
Native typeof() verifies the SQLite result storage class while json_type() independently verifies the source JSON kind; explicit JSON null remains distinguishable from a missing path.
JSON export preserves numeric, text and null result distinctions, including the maximum signed 64-bit integer as a JSON number.
XLSX export uses numeric cells for numeric values, shared strings for extracted text, and emits no formulas.
Typed CSV export/import restores the result carrier, exact JSON-derived text and kind marker into STRICT ANY and preserves SQL NULL.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_ -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other JSON consumers, computed expressions, spreadsheet-app re-import and installed editing remain open.
